summary: Guard --parallel N>1 to the 4B finetune model id and pre-flight the server's actual slot count, refusing rather than silently queueing behind a 1-slot server; document the PARALLEL <-> --parallel pairing on both scripts; needs 0c34642e

resolution.note: Model guard (check_parallel_model_guard) refuses --parallel N>1 for non-finetune model ids unless --allow-parallel-any-model; slot pre-flight (preflight_server_slots + llm.query_llamacpp_slots) queries GET /props (total_slots/n_parallel) falling back to GET /slots, warns-and-continues when unreachable/unparseable, refuses only on a positive too-low count. 20 new tests in test_tag_concepts_parallel_guard.py, all socket-free (stubbed urllib.request.urlopen).
